segments.name: Medical Devices
segments.description: Develops and commercializes wearable cardioverter defibrillator technology for patients at risk of sudden cardiac arrest.
segments.evidence: The Company has a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by leasing ASSURE System devices to patients and seeking reimbursement from governmental healthcare programs and private health insurance companies, including Medicare.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns revenues by seeking reimbursement for the product from governmental healthcare programs and private health insurance companies, including the federal Medicare program.
